notes: «أبي» has no name in the text: relation. «جماعة مشايخي» is a collective of teachers: unnamed.
«قال لي صاحب هذا القبر عن الرضا»: Ali b. Bilal relays the grave's occupant, who is named only in the scene (the grave of محمد بن إسماعيل بن بزيع); the speaker is left unnamed, not identified.
«عن الرضا» follows «عن» in the chain, so it stays narrator (owner ruling 2). «ره» and «(ع)» are stripped.
